_comment: Committed reproducibility pin for the VnCoreNLP word segmenter used by the
PINNED. The revision and the three SHA-256 values below were extracted by the
researcher from the provisioned Colab checkout with `git rev-parse HEAD`,
`git tag --points-at HEAD` and sha256 over the three required resources.
The probe verifies BOTH at run time: the checkout's HEAD must equal `revision`,
and every file's digest must equal the value below. Either mismatch fails
closed. A checkout without .git metadata still has its hashes checked, but
cannot be marked pinned, because this manifest pins a revision.
Changing release_tag, revision, required_jar or any sha256 is an EXPERIMENT
DEPENDENCY CHANGE and must be recorded in docs/spec/decisions.md.
This is neither a dataset nor a model checkpoint. It is a pin for the
word-segmentation dependency of PhoBERT preprocessing feasibility work.
